body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection OR compile-ref. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message on trip. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- All levels are real maps (pocket maps in Find.Maps, tick every game tick). Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + plateaus AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable).

## PARITY BATCH A (2026-07-24) — USER-VERIFIED
- **FORMATION GOTO (vanilla-exact)**: ABBelowGotoDrag = full MultiPawnGotoController mirror (drag-line lerped roots, BestOrderedGotoDestNear spacing + dests exclusion, DragGoto tick, 10t recompute, between-line, ghosts + circles + labels via LevelComp.MapComponentOnGUI). All selection mixes; cross pawns previewed from their stair exit (virtual swap), routed + replayed on release.
- **ONE-STEP REINSTALL** (Logistics/ReinstallAcrossLevels.cs): cross-level reinstall blueprint spawn auto-adds Uninstall designation on the source building; vanilla uninstalls, detector migrates, mini ferried, vanilla installs. Cancel removes the designation. TargetLevelFor skips blueprint-referenced minis (anti-bounce; urgent ignorePins wins).
- **STAIR FORBID — door parity**: CompForbiddable on stairs/ladders/elevators (not utility links). Mirrors IsForbiddenToPass exactly (comp-only, faction-scoped, drafted respect it, hostiles/mental ignore, allowed-area NEVER consulted). Either end seals the passage incl. elevator middle. Gated: NearestUsableStairs, StairRouter, StairIslands, relay anchors, float menus, driver FailOn.

## PARITY BATCH B (2026-07-24) — built, verification pending
- **NATURAL MEDITATION FOCI**: psycasters with no assigned spot probe vanilla FindMeditationSpot on linked levels (virtual swap at stair exit); travel on strictly stronger focus (+0.05 hysteresis). Non-psylink pawns never travel.
- **PENS ACROSS LEVELS** (Systems/PenAcrossLevels.cs): auto rehome ONLY when no local pen accepts; vanilla pen pick probed under DOUBLE virtual swap; driver ropes -> leads -> transfers both -> ABPendingOrders replay issues vanilla RopeToPen. Settled animals untouched.
- **CELL-TARGETED CASTS** (TryHandleGenericCell): location-accepting ITargetingSources clicked through open air: route-then-cast.
- **RITUAL PRISONERS + ANIMALS**: SECURE prisoners + colony animals (new SpawnedColonyAnimals scoped merge) join candidates and ride the stairs in gathers. Downed can't cross (timeout) — disclosed.

## PARITY BATCH C (2026-07-24) — built, verification pending (companion mods)
- **ROOFTOP AIRSHIP LANDINGS** (ABAirshipsCompat): LandShip ref-prefix -> sky level when the host mod's landing zone is painted on the rooftop and the surface zone is empty. Player-controlled, no settings.
- **SKY VISITOR ARRIVALS** (SkyArrivals.cs): visitor/traveler groups (vanilla + Hospitality override) divert 50% inside the worker when sky has player buildings + standable colony-reachable edge cell + usable stairs. Setting skyVisitorArrivals default ON.
- **HOSPITALITY GUEST ROAMING** (ABHospitalityCompat): lord retention (Notify_PawnLost suppressed only for pawn == StairTransfer.Transferring under LordJob_VisitColony), idle-guest roam to guest-bed/vendor levels (20%/900t, max 2 away), return on departure/overstay. Setting hospitalityRoaming default ON.
- **STRANDED-NEUTRAL SWEEP** (ABNeutralExit.cs): 600t — lord-less friendly humanlikes on pocket levels walk to the surface. LordMembershipInColumn shared helper.

## FOOD OPTIMALITY ACROSS LEVELS (2026-07-24, user report: berries beat the 2nd-floor fridge)
Old rule: cross-level food probe fired only when the level had NOTHING edible — any local snack won. New rule in Patch_GetFood_CrossLevel (NeedsPatches.cs): when vanilla's local pick is SUB-MEAL (preferability < MealSimple: berries, kibble, paste, raw), run vanilla's own FoodOptimality contest against each linked level's best source with the REAL travel folded into the distance term (walk to stairs + climb ticks/speed + exit to food). Reroute only when the far food wins (+1 hysteresis) — identical outcome to one big map, where merely-Hungry colonists filter sub-meal food out entirely (minPref MealAwful) and urgently-hungry ones weigh distance. Starving pawns always eat local (desperate scoring). Inventory food and pets never second-guessed. Local pick already a meal = zero probe cost. FoodNext cooldown charged on failed upgrade probes. KNOWN GAP: single-hop probe (basement berries vs sky fridge upgrades only via a surface hop that must itself win).

## LOGISTICS — unchanged (island rework + RELAY + URGENT; forbid-gated islands; export pin split; urgent fetch leg). KNOWN GAPS unchanged.
## AREAS / ZONES — unchanged. Stairs deliberately NOT area-gated (forbid comp is the passage control).
## CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT (Model B) — unchanged (BUG1 neutral retest pending; CE direct fire verified).
## SETTINGS — seven tabs + skyVisitorArrivals, hospitalityRoaming.

## Test plan (current)
- Batch B verify (isolated): anima meditation pull, cross-level take-to-pen, cell-cast below, ritual prisoner/animal gather, **berries-vs-fridge food upgrade**.
- Batch C verify (companionMods: Orion.Hospitality, joeownage.automatic.airships): rooftop landing zone, plateau visitors, guest tourism + return, stranded sweep.
- Older stack: relay/urgent with Allow Tool, BUG1 neutral CE retest, CE-absent palette run, translation audit, soak, publishing.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH. Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. CE. Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF. Medieval Trader Airships (+legacy), Hospitality (Continued). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-24 (5th pass): Batches A+forbid verified; B + C built; food-optimality fix built (user report). Next: Batch B test (isolated, incl. food fix), then Batch C with companion mods.
